candidates.title: Measure a fabricated contact sample
candidates.outcome: Observe holding force before and after controlled wear.
candidates.change: The candidate register identifies a possibility; it supplies no measured specimen here.
candidates.obstruction: No physical apparatus, calibrated sensor or specimen available.
candidates.route: Preregister forces, calibration and repeated wear measurements on an identified sample.
candidates.value: Could support a functional qualification; fabrication and lab costs are unknown.
candidates.alternative: An independent testing laboratory or an existing measured component.
candidates.scale: Repeat per material and operating range with physical process limits.
candidates.test: Run one calibrated before/after wear cycle with uncertainty records.

candidates.title: Source an independently tested component
candidates.outcome: Compare an already qualified passive component against the intended operating range.
candidates.change: No accessible component data or matching operating envelope is supplied.
candidates.obstruction: An off-the-shelf sample is not the newly fabricated surface.
candidates.route: Obtain rights-authorized exact-part evidence and compare the test conditions.
candidates.value: May reduce development cost but does not necessarily settle this specimen.
candidates.alternative: Commission matched measurements on the new sample.
candidates.scale: Reuse covers documented matching conditions only.
candidates.test: Check evidence identifies the same sample, force and wear protocol.

candidates.title: Design a measurement instrument
candidates.outcome: Prepare a test design for the eventual calibrated experiment.
candidates.change: The charter allows a previously missing acceptance instrument as a research hypothesis.
candidates.obstruction: A design cannot establish measured load behavior.
candidates.route: Build a data capture specification linked to calibration and specimen identity.
candidates.value: May reduce future setup cost; no actual result or funding is observed.
candidates.alternative: Use an existing calibrated laboratory protocol.
candidates.scale: Reusable protocol still requires physical trials.
candidates.test: Independently demonstrate the instrument meets calibration requirements.

objections.claim: The inventory describes provisional work, not an experiment on a specific specimen.

Evidence about a purchased component would require proof it measured the exact requested surface.

fit.check: Independently check instrument calibration and measured force on the actual sample, before and after wear. Neither sample nor measurements were supplied.
